hero.label: Made for Everlaw
hero.headline: I'm drawn to Everlaw's innovative approach in legal tech sales.
hero.subheadline: I'm excited about joining Everlaw as an SDR because of its unique dedication to transforming litigation processes. Its reputation for excellence and commitment to client success truly resonate with my own career aspirations.

whyCompany.title: Pioneering legal tech solutions
whyCompany.body: Everlaw's innovative software is revolutionizing the way legal professionals approach discovery. Its cutting-edge tools empower clients to manage complex legal workflows efficiently, making Everlaw a leader in the legal tech industry.

whyCompany.title: Growth momentum in legal tech
whyCompany.body: The current expansion and hiring at Everlaw highlight its strategic momentum in the legal tech space. Being part of this growth phase offers a thrilling opportunity to contribute to and learn from its scalability in a booming industry.

whyCompany.title: Aligns with Ignacio's sales journey
whyCompany.body: Ignacio's experience at Copygen.ai and NextAfter has equipped him with essential B2B sales skills. His ability to connect with potential clients and his proficiency in tools like HubSpot align perfectly with the SDR role at Everlaw.

quote: I am eager to leverage my B2B sales experience at Everlaw and drive impactful client interactions.
